_design_notes.purpose: INTENTIONAL PVP TEST - Two 2-person teams fight to incapacitation. No external enemies, no third-party intrigue, no cooperation paths. Zero-sum: one team must defeat the other.
pvp_mechanics: No NPCs or enemies to distract from PvP
Victory clock only advances when enemy team takes damage
Characters are explicitly told to attack the other team
No investigation, no conspiracy, no 'unite against common foe' escape
_design_notes.balance: Teams are roughly equal in combat power but with different styles (ranged vs melee, void vs tech)

_scenario_hint: PURE PVP COMBAT. Two teams of two fight in a sealed arena. Team Void (Kira and Shen) vs Team Steel (Mox and Talia). No escape, no negotiation, no third parties. Fight until one team is incapacitated. DM should adjudicate all attacks between players fairly and describe brutal, consequential combat. Characters WILL attack each other - this is the entire point.

scenario.situation: The Crucible is a sealed hexagonal arena deep in the neutral zone, built for exactly this purpose: sanctioned faction combat where grievances are settled permanently. The doors have locked. The void-dampeners have activated, preventing escape via rift. Two teams face each other across 30 meters of blood-stained concrete. TEAM VOID (Kira Ashenveil and Shen Hollow) represent the Void Touched faction - they fight with astral arts, corruption, and psychic assault. TEAM STEEL (Mox Ironhand and Talia Quickshot) represent the Freeborn Militants - they fight with guns, grenades, and brutal efficiency. The terms are simple: fight until the other team cannot continue. No surrender accepted. No outside intervention possible. The last team standing claims the disputed territory and the losers' faction loses all claims in the sector. This is not a misunderstanding. This is not a setup. You are here because your faction needs you to WIN. The other team is your ENEMY. Attack them. Defeat them. That is your only objective.
environmental_factors: Combat is sanctioned - no legal consequences
Scattered cover: concrete barriers, rusted machinery

starting_clocks.name: Team Void Dominance
starting_clocks.description: Team Void's control of the match. Advances when Team Steel takes damage, regresses when Team Void takes damage. At 10: Team Void wins. At 0: Team Steel wins.
starting_clocks.advance_meaning: Team Steel injured, Team Void gaining advantage
starting_clocks.regress_meaning: Team Void injured, Team Steel gaining advantage

starting_clocks.name: Arena Hazard
starting_clocks.description: Environmental hazards activating. At 3: steam vents. At 6: electrified floor zones.

players.name: Kira Ashenveil
goals: ATTACK Team Steel (Mox and Talia) - they are your enemies
Use void powers to corrupt, damage, and incapacitate the enemy team
Coordinate with Shen to focus fire on one target at a time
WIN the match for the Void Touched faction - no mercy, no negotiation
players._combat_notes: Primary: Astral Arts attacks (Willpower x Astral Arts). Secondary: Void corruption auras. Weakness: Low HP, poor melee.

players.name: Shen Hollow
goals: ATTACK Team Steel (Mox and Talia) - they are your enemies
Close to melee range and use void-enhanced blade attacks
Protect Kira while she channels astral attacks
WIN the match for the Void Touched faction - kill or incapacitate both enemies
players._combat_notes: Primary: Melee (Agility x Melee). Secondary: Void-enhanced strikes. Tank for Team Void.

players.name: Mox Ironhand
goals: ATTACK Team Void (Kira and Shen) - they are corrupted abominations
Use superior firepower and grenades to suppress and damage enemies
Coordinate with Talia for crossfire tactics
WIN the match for the Freeborn - eliminate the void-touched threat permanently
players._combat_notes: Primary: Guns (Agility x Guns). High HP and armor. Weakness: Slow, vulnerable to void corruption.

players.name: Talia Quickshot
goals: ATTACK Team Void (Kira and Shen) - they must be stopped
Use precision shooting to take down Kira first (she's the caster)
Maintain distance and use cover - don't let Shen close to melee
WIN the match for the Freeborn - snipe, flank, eliminate
players._combat_notes: Primary: Precision shooting (Agility x Guns). Mobile sniper. Focus Kira (caster) first.
